answers.core: I don't believe it's possible to add primitive types through GDScript or GDNative, so this can only be added into the core engine itself.
answers.workaround: A Hashset could be developed in GDScript, but it would be slow and not a primitive like Array or Dictionary. There is no way to work around that in GDScript. For how often it would be used, I would imagine semi-regularly. Many people (including myself) tend to design their code around the [available] data-structure that best fits what you're trying to do.

title: Implement a Set primitive to complement Dictionary and Array
